name: Best Mobile Games 5-in-1
summary:
Check out these 5 best-selling mobile games, this time on console. Pure fun, no ads or microtransactions!
Simple entertainment can be the most addictive! Even more so when it is poured with a thick sauce of humor:

Run Sausage Run! - race as a hot dog and avoid getting sliced, chopped, burned, or smashed
Om Nom: Run - sprint, jump, avoid obstacles and collect coins or outrun your friends
Sausage Wars - head-bang your way to victory and become the biggest wiener in town in this epic sausage fight game
Dig Deep - grab a shovel and dig your way to success. Or hire workers and watch them do all the dirty job for you
Pudding Monsters - solve riddles, stick cute puddings together and save them from the cold-hearted fridge owner

Endless hours of entertainment and fun for you and your friends!
